# Disagreement Log — GTH_094

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 94
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 94 | "He who seeks" | "One who seeks" | "The one who searches" | Universal subject: masculine generic vs. neutral vs. searching |
| 2 | 94 | "to him it will be opened" | "to one who knocks it will be opened" | "the door will be opened to the one who knocks" | Door: implied vs. explicit |

**Total disagreements: 2**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "He who seeks" (traditional rendering of the Q saying) and "to him it will be opened" (dative construction preserved, door implied).
